summary: Text drawn as a code a phone camera reads, dark on a white tile in either scheme.

props.name: value
props.description: The text the code holds, usually a link.

props.name: label
props.description: The code's name to screen readers. Without it they hear the value.

props.name: modules
props.description: How each module is drawn. Square reads at the smallest sizes.

props.name: level
props.description: How much of the code can be covered and still read: `L` 7%, `M` 15%, `Q` 25%, `H` 30%. An `icon` raises it to `H`.

props.name: icon
props.description: A glyph in the middle, on a dark key, such as your app's mark.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius of the tile and the three eyes. Inherits the nearest `Shape`.

props.name: animated
props.description: The modules popping in from the middle when the value changes. Reduced motion turns it off.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. `merge` folds them in last, so one here replaces the component's own class for the same utility.
